> backend@1.0.0 gate:composition
> node tools/gates/checkCompositionRoot.js

gate: composition-root (execution plan, Phase 15 — workers move to production scheduling)
  FAIL — 1 violation(s) across 18 registered worker(s):
    coordinator (tier 0, workers/coordinator.worker)
        [LEADER_ONLY_NOT_COMPOSABLE] declared LEADER_ONLY and reachable, but it CANNOT BE COMPOSED: the round loop needs `expandCandidates`, `pricedCandidateFor` and `commit`. The first two resolve, through plan/insertion.js → planBuilder.hopsForSequence → routing/cellPairCache.hopsFor, to an injected `route` function — the routing engine. **No routing engine is selected**: that is execution-plan item B1, whose Step 5 is blocked on D1 (no authoritative operating region), D3 (no fleet speed model) and D8 (no extract vintage), none of which is an engineering task. `npm run routing:readiness` reports BLOCKED and refuses to fabricate one. Starting the coordinator against an invented router would assign real work on invented travel times, which is worse than not assigning it. [requires: expandCandidates, pricedCandidateFor, commit] [owner: B1 — Operations + Commercial (D1), Product + Fleet Engineering (D3), Operations (D8)] — this blocker is EXTERNAL to this repository and no commit here closes it.
